emulation_boot.launch_recipe:
# inside hyperloom-srv (that is where /opt/envs/vllm + ROCm live)
export PYTHONPATH=<specialist run>/worktree        # patched vLLM source
export VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=<fresh dir>                  # AOT graph is hash-keyed:
export TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR=<fresh dir>/inductor # a selection-only patch does NOT invalidate it
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=0 HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=1
vllm serve /mnt/kioxia-cm6-3t8/ai/models/ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-397B-FP8 \
  --port <port> --tensor-parallel-size=8 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \
  --max-model-len 6144 --trust-remote-code
emulation_boot.measured_note: single boot, specialist server; optimizer baseline still 0.0

measured_ttft_tps.caveat: specialist validation server, not the optimizer's sealed baseline; no warmup/sigma protocol; conc capped at 8 to limit interference
measured_ttft_tps.reference_same_host: llama.cpp Q8_0 arm 47.28 tok/s decode (with ngram+MTP speculation; this path has none)

emulation_boot.patch: FP8W8A8EmulationLinearKernel (dense linears dequant FP8->BF16 at load, then F.linear)

pitfalls.description: fp8 臂失败时 orchestrator 可能进入 brain-dead（主进程 ep_poll 存活、0 子进程、robustness 静默，命中本机 issue#3 Part A 形态，turn 上限 36 也在 RCA+enablement 路径烧穿）——判活要看 tick 是否推进，别信 stop_reason 为空
coordinator 被杀后 specialist 拉起的 vllm serve 会以独立 pgid 孤儿化占卡，必须枚举 PID 显式清理（rocm-smi --showpids / ps --sort=start_time），且容器 root 写的 kb/state 文件回读要 chmod

hybrid GDN+Mamba 状态缓存限死 CUDA graph 捕获：官方配方本模型的故障项 "assert num_cache_lines >= batch"，修法 --max-cudagraph-capture-size 调低（默认 512）。本臂启动日志已见同族形态：attention block size 528 / mamba page size padding 1.34% (interface.py:911/935)
官方建议 text-only 时不要同时开 vision 相关项：--language-model-only 与 --mm-encoder-tp-mode data 互斥；encoder DP 会额外吃显存，需要同时调 --gpu-memory-utilization

在跑的 Hyperloom run 会主动回收外来 GPU 进程，侧路探测无法与之共存：session 20260915T161838Z-ba2694ea 的 specialist 8628519056b24176b3fa5c9a0e106dd6 读到外来探测脚本后执行 'kill -TERM -35120'，把已跑到 CUDA graph capture 的独立仿真服务直接杀掉去腾卡。要独立测这份仿真路线，只能等 run 收官（或在 --resume-from 之前先测）

remaining_gaps.description: vLLM fp8 weight-only bf16-dequant 后端（非 scaled_mm 路径）在 gfx90a 是否可用作显式 --quantization 覆盖，未测
反量化仿真路线的端到端基线未拿下：加载通过但 /v1/models 未 ready，首次 torch.compile 很慢（Dynamo 12.4 s 起步 + shm broadcast 60 s 无块告警属编译期正常形态）
官方硬件无关旗标里未在本臂试过的：--language-model-only、VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0、--enable-expert-parallel/-dp 形状、--kv-cache-dtype fp8（hybrid 缓存下的实际收益未知）
反量化仿真路线的 TTFT / 输出吞吐仍未测：本次探测在 graph capture 阶段被同机 run 回收，而 run 自己的基准又被预算跳过（grid_runner: 4293s left cannot fit 2x7800s → variant not_run）

snapshot.status_note: 原判 dead 针对"无补丁的 stock vLLM fp8 路线"；反量化仿真内核已证明可加载权重，端到端未测，故降级为 experimental（本行随后由 optimizer CLOSE 的 sediment 覆写）

silicon_gated_on_gfx90a: FP8 checkpoint + FP8 GEMM: the entire official AMD lane runs Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 (W8A8, dynamic per-token activations); gfx90a (CDNA2) has no FP8 matrix core, and torch._scaled_mm refuses anything below MI300+ -> engine init dies
--kv-cache-dtype fp8 in the fp8/nvfp4 variant extra_args
transferable_to_mi250x: --language-model-only (skip vision tower): architecture-level, frees HBM per die on a text-only workload where weights alone eat ~48-55 GiB of 64 GiB
VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0 + VLLM_DEEP_GEMM_WARMUP=skip (base_env): DeepGEMM is CUDA-only; avoids pointless warmup on ROCm
--reasoning-parser qwen3 (output parsing only; also gates --default-chat-template-kwargs enable_thinking=false)
the num_cache_lines>=batch -> --max-cudagraph-capture-size pitfall: hybrid GDN/Mamba state cache bounds graph capture on every GPU (our boot already logs mamba/attention page-size padding)
MTP is present in the checkpoint (mtp.* tensors) -> --speculative-config mtp is a model-level lever, but the vendor explicitly flags MTP on AMD as under development
--enable-expert-parallel / -dp 8 style MoE parallelism: architecture-level, but xGMI all-to-all cost on MI250X is unmeasured
